chunks: "The structure of Ibrahim, peace be upon him, had a length of thirty cubits, a width of twenty-two cubits, and a thickness of nine cubits. When Quraysh built it, they clothed it with cloaks."

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام, to whom the original building is attributed
key_terms.الْأَرْدِيَةَ: cloaks or garments used to cover it
key_terms.بُنْيَانُ: the structure or building being described
key_terms.ذِرَاعًا: a cubit, the unit used to measure the building
key_terms.قُرَيْشًا: the Quraysh tribe who later rebuilt it

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the dimensions of Ibrahim's building and the Quraysh covering it?
ai.summary: This report describes the dimensions of the structure built by Ibrahim عليه السلام and notes that Quraysh later covered it with cloaks when they rebuilt it. The narration preserves a historical detail connected to the Ka'bah and its construction.
